bibliographic_identity.title: Is Nocturnal Pollination Important for Crop Production? Experimental Evidence From Small Fruit Crops

design.pollination_treatment_allocation: different inflorescences, treatments replicated on different plants
design.measured_fruit_set: success and failure among initial flowers per inflorescence
design.measured_seed_set: seed count per fruit conditional on already formed fruit
design.original_published_model_fruit_set: binomial GLM inflorescence, year covariate for both Ribes species; individual plant random effects not fitted
design.independent_treatment_assignment_unit: inflorescence within plant, not 850 independent plants; repeated flowers clustered

fruit_set.Rubus idaeus: No detected treatment effect (global test p=0.569)
fruit_set.Ribes rubrum: Day and day+night > closed, night-only versus closed not significant; day+night versus day not significant in published pairwise tests
fruit_set.Ribes nigrum: day+night > closed (p<0.001), day+night > day-only (p=0.003), night-only > closed p=0.082 (unresolved)

planned_reanalysis.phase: Original Figshare file manifest first; not claiming raw reanalysis done
planned_reanalysis.V_primary: 1 - (successfully formed mature fruits per initially assigned flower under day-only)/(same outcome under day+night), stratified species and year
planned_reanalysis.V_second: 1 - (total seeds formed per initially assigned flower under day-only)/(same outcome under day+night); total seeds includes zero for original flowers not forming fruit
planned_reanalysis.avoid: Comparing only seeds per formed fruit conditions on a post-exclusion event and cannot be interpreted as total seed production; do not fill truly missing outcomes as zero.
planned_reanalysis.store_variance_and_cluster: plant, inflorescence, experimental year/site; no independent 850 flowers
planned_reanalysis.is_new_publication_to_Kendall_Nicholson_: first online 2025, Kendall search literature through 2022; need confirm explicit duplicate registry DOI exclusion

original_source_reanalysis.outcome: fruit success divided by originally assigned flowers, not mature seed number
original_source_reanalysis.evidence: Descriptive original outcome comparison from one study, 2 geographically different sites in 2 years; SE and plant IDs not in author files.
original_source_reanalysis.qctreatment_mismatch: Fruit_quality.csv contains 2020 BC closed 12 measured fruits vs Fruit_set.csv only 3 successes; 2020 BC open has 3 quality rows vs 14 fruit successes. Thus quality table cannot be treated as exactly one row per formed fruit with the same arm labels.
original_source_reanalysis.caution: No ALAN manipulation; no inference about actual moth contribution, future ALAN losses or island×ALAN; prevent animal visits from being inferred from pollination time access.
